name: PUDL power generation
description: US power plant generation, plant locations, cooling equipment, emissions; EIA and EPA public records.

name: Sentinel-2 imagery
description: Daytime satellite imagery; cloud masking essential. Can inspect cooling plumes, reservoirs, land cover.

name: Global Water Watch
description: Satellite reservoir surface area histories. Area is not water volume, generation or an early warning by itself.

name: VIIRS night lights
description: Satellite nighttime light composites. Area-level brightness is not proof of clinic power, and onsite solar may be invisible. Provider registration may be required.

name: OpenStreetMap places
description: Mapped clinics, settlements, roads and other places. Coverage varies; not a complete facility register.

name: Open-Meteo weather
description: Historical temperature, precipitation, wind and other weather variables.
